maintenance_led.reason: Sells outsourced claims management, managed care and bill review services to employers and insurers, not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by employers, insurers and third-party administrators for workers' compensation, auto and liability claims; some public-sector clients are minor.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through claims, managed care and technology services to clients like Texas Roadhouse; no acquisition roll-up pattern.

mission_critical.reason: Handles ongoing workers' compensation claims on its Care platform; switching means claim migration, integration and disruption to regulated injured-worker care.
